about.meta_description: Meet Marimbas Home — 11 years of modern Mexican hospitality in CDMX and Chiapas.
about.title: About Marimbas Home
about.subtitle: 11 years creating homes away from home in Mexico
about.story_p1: Marimbas Home was born in 2015 with a single property in Condesa, Mexico City. The idea was simple: offer travelers a space that feels like home, with the warmth and personal touch that only a local host can provide.
about.story_p2: Since then, we've grown to 22 properties across four unique zones in Mexico: the vibrant Condesa in CDMX, the Chiapas capital Tuxtla Gutiérrez, the magical town of Coita, and the peaceful Berriozábal. Each space has its own personality, but they all share our commitment to comfort, cleanliness, and genuine hospitality.
about.story_p3: Today, over 5,000 guests have trusted us with their stay. We remain a small, close-knit team, which allows us to maintain a personalized level of service that big chains simply can't match.
about.value_hospitality_desc: Every guest is treated like family. We care about making your stay memorable.
about.value_trust_desc: Transparent pricing, direct communication, and no fine print.
about.value_local_desc: We know every neighborhood. We connect you with the authentic side of Mexico.
about.value_experience_desc: Thousands of successful stays back up the way we do things.
